name: agent-safe-pipeline-workspace
description: Reference architecture for executing AI-agent actions through an independent authorization boundary.
author: Decionis, Inc.

scripts.precommit: node scripts/PreCommit.mjs && pnpm metadata:check && pnpm fixture:check && pnpm dossiers:check && pnpm license:check && pnpm lint && pnpm security && pnpm performance
scripts.spec:schema: node scripts/GenerateIntentSchema.mjs && node scripts/GenerateExecutorSchema.mjs && node scripts/GenerateApiProfiles.mjs && node scripts/GenerateProfileSchema.mjs
scripts.spec:check: node scripts/GenerateIntentSchema.mjs --check && node scripts/GenerateExecutorSchema.mjs --check && node scripts/GenerateApiProfiles.mjs --check && node scripts/GenerateProfileSchema.mjs --check
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @decionis/agent-safe-pipeline build && pnpm --filter @decionis/agentsafe build && pnpm -r typecheck
scripts.verify: pnpm format && pnpm lint && pnpm metadata:check && pnpm fixture:check && pnpm dossiers:check && pnpm license:check && pnpm security && pnpm dependabot:check && pnpm discovery && pnpm performance && pnpm typecheck && pnpm spec:check && pnpm test:automation && pnpm test && pnpm build
scripts.examples:prove: pnpm --filter @decionis/agent-safe-example-golden-adversarial demo && pnpm --filter @decionis/agent-safe-example-whisper-boundary demo && pnpm --filter @decionis/agent-safe-example-crm-outreach demo && pnpm --filter @decionis/agent-safe-example-infra-scale demo && pnpm --filter @decionis/agent-safe-example-changed-conditions demo && pnpm --filter @decionis/agent-safe-example-staged-change demo && pnpm --filter @decionis/agent-safe-example-trusted-executor demo && pnpm --filter @decionis/agent-safe-example-acceptance demo
